patch_description: Add a symmetry-guided mid-layer of RY rotations to the existing ansatz. This mid-layer is placed between the existing Layer 2 (RY) and Layer 3 (CZ) and uses three new parameter keys (ry_mid_corner, ry_mid_edge, ry_mid_center) with shared usage across the corresponding wires. The goal is to boost expressive power and trainability with minimal parameter blow-up, leveraging the board's 4-fold symmetry while keeping the connectivity and overall depth manageable. This mirrors proven strategies that insert symmetry-shared rotations mid-block to enhance performance without drastically increasing parameter counts.
